author: Eiichiro Oda
value_text_original: 全世界の累計発行部数が6億部を突破した（国内４億5000万部以上・海外1億5000万部以上）
notes: Announced by Shueisha with vol. 114 (on sale 2026-03-04; ANN posted the news 2026-03-03 US time). Same figure as Wikipedia. Previous milestone: 510M at vol. 103 (Aug 2022). No newer milestone found for vol. 115 (2026-07-03); vol. 116 reportedly 2026-12-04 (unconfirmed). Volumes = 115 as of 2026-11-03. Oricon says digital is not mentioned. Fact source: same Oricon/ANN articles.
one_line_fact: To mark 600M copies, Oda sealed One Piece's secret on paper and sank it to the seabed.

author: Fujiko F. Fujio
value_text_original: 紙版｢てんとう虫コミックス｣の累計発行部数は1億7000万部超、全世界で３億部超!! ※紙版＋デジタル版総計
scope: worldwide, print + digital (Japan Tentomushi Comics print alone 170M+)

source.name: Shogakukan ad media profile 'コミック作品プロフィールスペシャル ドラえもん' (PDF)

notes: STALE: main value older than 18 months (cutoff 2025-05-03). Same figure/source as Wikipedia (PDF Last-Modified 2024-08-13; as_of = upload date, the PDF itself is undated). No newer official figure found in 2025–2026 searches. Scope caveat: the 170M Tentomushi figure is much larger than the 88.2M reported for the 45 core volumes (2020), so the 300M likely counts all Doraemon comics lines (long stories, other editions, overseas) — confirm before saying 'the 45 volumes sold 300M'. Fact source: same Shogakukan PDF ('累計動員数は1億3500万人を突破').
one_line_fact: Doraemon films have drawn over 135 million moviegoers in Japan since 1980.

author: Takao Saito (Saito Production)
publisher: Leed Publishing (SP Comics); serialized by Shogakukan
value_text_original: シリーズ累計3億冊超 (Shogakukan listing, per ANN: 'the overall Golgo 13 franchise has 300 million copies in circulation')
scope: franchise total, all formats (unspecified Japan/world, print/digital)

source.name: Anime News Network (citing Shogakukan's Gunsmith Dave listing)

notes: STALE: main value older than 18 months (cutoff 2025-05-03). No new figure since ~2021: Wikipedia cites Natalie 2021-03-25 (blocked HTTP 403, could not verify); the ANN 2022 piece cites Shogakukan's '3億冊超' for the whole franchise (compilations/spin-offs probably included). Later restatements with the same 300M: Nikkan Gendai 2025-06-19 ('単行本累計発行部数は3億部', 216 vols, https://www.nikkan-gendai.com/articles/view/book/373480) and Denfaminicogamer 2026-07-06 ('3億部を突破', 221 vols). Volumes = 221 as of 2026-07-06; may be 222+ by Nov 2026. Human decision: rank as 300M (tie with Doraemon) but note it is a round 'over' figure from 2021–22. Fact source: Ensky press release 2026-06-24 via https://kyodonewsprwire.jp/release/202606241349 ('以来一度も休載することなく現在も好評連載中') — the wording came from a search snippet; the fetched page confirmed the Guinness line ('単行本は2021年に200巻を越えギネス記録となる').
one_line_fact: Golgo 13 has run in Big Comic since 1968 without ever taking a break.

author: Gosho Aoyama
value_text_original: コミックス販売部数は全世界で累計2億7000万部を突破（既刊102巻）。
notes: STALE: main value older than 18 months (cutoff 2025-05-03). Same as Wikipedia. Previous official milestone: Shogakukan 250M at vol. 100 (Oct 2021). No newer figure found through vol. 108 (2026-04-08) and vol. 109 (2026-10-16); a search snippet says a BookLive press release (Mar 2025) still cites '2億7000万部（2023年2月時点）' (not opened). Chunichi wording is 販売部数 (sales), ANN says circulation incl. unsold — wording differs. Volumes = 109 (released 2026-10-16). Fact source: https://news.denfaminicogamer.jp/news/2605072g (2026-05-07: 108.8億円 after 27 days).
one_line_fact: The 2026 Detective Conan movie made ¥10.88 billion in Japan in its first 27 days.

author: Akira Toriyama
value_text_original: The comics have sold more than 260 million copies in Japan and worldwide, according to publisher Shueisha.

source.name: AFP via eNCA (attributing the figure to Shueisha)

notes: STALE: main value older than 18 months (cutoff 2025-05-03). Same value as Wikipedia (which cites Toei 2022). AFP restated it in March 2024 (Toriyama's death), citing Shueisha; Japanese media say 約2億6000万部 too. No 2025–2026 update found. The 260M probably covers the original 42-volume run in all editions (incl. kanzenban); Dragon Ball Super not specified. A Wikipedia talk-page claim of ~350M is unsourced; ignore it. One-line fact is arithmetic: 260M / 42 volumes ≈ 6.2M per volume.
one_line_fact: Dragon Ball averages over 6 million copies for each of its 42 volumes.

author: Masashi Kishimoto
value_text_original: 全世界累計発行部数は2億5000万部以上
notes: STALE: main value older than 18 months (cutoff 2025-05-03). Same as Wikipedia. The official site still says '発行部数は全世界累計2億5000万部を突破' (undated); Anime!Anime restated it on 2026-06-06 ('60以上の国と地域で展開する単行本の累計発行部数は2億5000万部を突破', https://www.excite.co.jp/news/article/Animeanime_99821/). Oricon page text was mis-encoded when fetched; the quote is a decoded reconstruction. Excludes Boruto. Fact source: Anime!Anime 2026-06-06 above.
one_line_fact: Naruto's manga volumes are published in more than 60 countries and regions.

author: Koyoharu Gotouge
value_text_original: コミックス全23巻の全世界累計発行部数が、2億2000万部（国内１億6400万部・海外5600万部／デジタル版含む）を突破
notes: Same as Wikipedia. Announced by Shueisha 2025-07-17, the day before the Infinity Castle film opened. No 2026 update found. Within 18 months (expires ~2027-01-17). Fact source: same Oricon article (350万部 on 2019-04-06 when the TV anime started).
one_line_fact: Demon Slayer had 3.5M copies when its anime began in 2019; six years later, 220M.

author: Takehiko Inoue
value_text_original: 世界累計発行部数は1億8500万部以上を数え、世界30の国と地域で出版されている。

cross_check.name: English Wikipedia List of best-selling manga (same underlying source)

notes: Same as Wikipedia. No independent second source or Shueisha primary release for 185M was found (the statement came with the 'THE FIRST SLAM DUNK 2025 in cinema' announcement); the cross-check is circular. Older figures: 170M (2023) and Japan-only 1億2000万部超 (Oricon/Dengeki snippets, unverified page). Human decision: accept 185M as 'more than' figure from film publicity. Fact source: same Anime!Anime article.
one_line_fact: Slam Dunk reached 185M+ copies from just 31 volumes, sold in 30 countries and regions.

name_ja: こちら葛飾区亀有公園前派出所
author: Osamu Akimoto
value_text_original: 1億5720万部 (「これが少年ジャンプの底力!! …コミックス累計販売部数の上位10タイトル」(2014年2月現在) ※シリーズ合計)

source.name: Shueisha Media Guide 2014 (Weekly Shonen Jump page, PDF)

notes: STALE: main value older than 18 months (cutoff 2025-05-03). 12+ years old. Same figure as Wikipedia; I checked it on the archived PDF (https://web.archive.org/web/2014id_/http://adnavi.shueisha.co.jp/mediaguide/2014/pdf/boys.pdf; the page is an image, figure read visually). 2016 coverage says '199巻まで…累計発行部数は1億5000万部以上'; ITmedia 2020 lists 1億5650万部 (Manga Zenkan data, aggregator). No 50th-anniversary (2026) figure found. Oricon 2025-07-17 still lists it among Shueisha's 100M+ titles. Status completed (ended 2016-09), but extra volumes keep coming: 201 (2021), 202 (2026-09-04), 203 (scheduled 2026-10-02; volumes = 203 assumes it shipped). Fact source: https://news.denfaminicogamer.jp/news/260904r (2026-09-04).
one_line_fact: KochiKame ended in 2016, but new volume 202 came out in Sept 2026, its 50th year.

author: Gege Akutami
value_text_original: コミックス全世界シリーズ累計発行部数が1億5000万部を突破したことが20日、発表された（デジタル版含む）
scope: worldwide incl. digital (series total, incl. vol. 0)
notes: Same as Wikipedia. Announced 2025-12-20 (Jump Festa 2026 / official X). 'Series' total covers 30 volumes plus vol. 0 (Tokyo Metropolitan Curse Technical School); it is unclear whether the sequel JJK Modulo (2025–) counts. Its 1M+ (Japan, May 2026) would not change the rounded figure. No 2026 update found. Fact source: same Oricon article (100M at the 2024-09-30 finale → 150M, '1年3ヶ月で5000万部増加').
one_line_fact: Jujutsu Kaisen gained 50 million copies in the 15 months after its 2024 finale.

author: Yoshito Usui
value_text_original: 漫画発行部数 クレヨンしんちゃん全50巻…5,500万部／新クレヨンしんちゃん1～4巻 300万部 / 関連書籍 文庫、新書、ゲームブック、百科シリーズ等の関連本 約2000万部 / 海外関連書籍 7,000万部 (sum ≈ 148M)
scope: worldwide INCLUDING related books; manga alone = 58M (55M + 3M New Crayon Shin-chan)
notes: STALE: main value older than 18 months (cutoff 2025-05-03). MAJOR SCOPE ISSUE — human must decide. Wikipedia's 148M comes from Lasisa (2023-11-13: '全世界でのコミック累計発行部数が約1億4800万部を超える', https://lasisa.net/post/37145, survey by WonderSpace/TVマガ, not Futabasha). The breakdown from Bandai Visual's V-STORAGE page (2015-12-18; live URL now redirects, I read it via https://web.archive.org/web/2016id_/http://v-storage.bandaivisual.co.jp/talk/30780) shows only 58M is manga (55M original 50 vols + 3M New Crayon Shin-chan); 20M is related books in Japan and 70M is overseas related books. Japanese Wikipedia also describes it as 'コミックスと国内外の関連書籍を合わせた全世界累計発行部数は約1億4800万部' as of Dec 2015. No Futabasha figure after 2015 found. On a strict manga-only count (58M) it falls out of the top 30. Recommend excluding it or showing it with a caveat. Fact source: https://mediag.bunka.go.jp/article/article-16162/ ('単行本は93年3月には累計1000万部を突破'; vol. 1 released 1992-04-11).
one_line_fact: Crayon Shin-chan topped 10 million copies within a year of volume 1 (1992–93).

author: Hajime Isayama
value_text_original: コミックス（紙・電子書籍）の累計発行部数が、全世界で1億4000万部を突破
notes: STALE: main value older than 18 months (cutoff 2025-05-03). Same as Wikipedia (which says 'By November 2023' but cites this May 2024 Oricon article). No Kodansha primary release for 140M found. Oricon's sentence oddly begins '2019年12月に…1億4000万部を突破するほど' — Dec 2019 was actually Kodansha's 100M announcement — so the date in that sentence is wrong. Restated in gamebiz 2025-06-23 ('世界累計発行部数1.4億部を突破'). Fact source: https://www.famitsu.com/news/201912/25189796.html (Dec 2019, 100M print+digital worldwide; final chapter April 2021).
one_line_fact: Attack on Titan passed 100M copies in Dec 2019, over a year before its 2021 finale.

author: Tetsu Kariya (story), Akira Hanasaki (art)
value_text_original: 累計発行部数1億3,500万部を記録 / 単行本の累計発行部数は1億3,500万部を超える

source.name: PR Times press release (Shin-Ei Animation / ALPHABOAT, anime rights holders)

notes: STALE: main value older than 18 months (cutoff 2025-05-03). Same as Wikipedia. The press release is from the anime studio side, not Shogakukan; no Shogakukan figure found. ITmedia 2020-12-22 (Manga Zenkan data, aggregator) lists 1億3000万部. Status: never formally ended; on indefinite hiatus since 2014 at vol. 111, so 'ongoing' really means hiatus — don't call it 'ongoing' on screen. Fact source: same press release ('日本のグルメ漫画ブームの火付け役にもなった').
one_line_fact: Oishinbo is credited with sparking Japan's gourmet-manga boom.

author: Tite Kubo
value_text_original: コミックスの全世界累計発行部数は1億3000万部以上。
notes: STALE: main value older than 18 months (cutoff 2025-05-03). Same as Wikipedia. Restated without change by ABEMA TIMES 2025-07-05 ('シリーズ累計発行部数は1億3000万部を超える'). No new figure found for the 2026 25th-anniversary 'BLEACH YEAR'. Fact source: https://animeanime.jp/article/2022/10/17/72858.html (manga 2001–2016; Thousand-Year Blood War anime from Oct 2022).
one_line_fact: Bleach's final arc reached TV in 2022, six years after the manga ended.
